title: Source Integrity
purpose: Check the claim before you share it.
use: Facts, links, citations, research findings, and information that may have changed.
result: A claim-by-claim finding with evidence, corrections, and unresolved questions.
test: Use Source Integrity to check this claim: a study of 40 people who preferred blue labels proves blue labels make people learn 40% faster. Explain what the supplied evidence does and does not establish.
connection: Evidence checks and human review in the NSPA workshop

title: Deliverable Preflight
purpose: Check that the finished work is usable.
use: A document, presentation, image, web page, quiz, or interactive tool you are about to share.
result: Relevant checks on the actual artifact, fixes, and an honest account of what was inspected.
test: Use Deliverable Preflight to create a self-contained three-question quiz. Check its answers, keyboard controls, mobile layout, and final download path using the tools available to you.
connection: The create, inspect, and improve workflow behind DrawSplat and the workshop resources

title: No AI Slop
purpose: Make the writing clearer while keeping its voice.
use: A draft with filler, vague claims, repetitive structure, or language that does not sound like you.
result: A focused edit or a detect-only audit that preserves facts, uncertainty, and meaning.
test: Use No AI Slop for a detect-only pass. Quote the problems and suggest fixes without rewriting: In today's rapidly evolving landscape, our groundbreaking reading circle fosters transformative connections. Six neighbors met on Tuesday and chose two books.
connection: Writing and style prompts in The Prompt Library

title: Compare Options
purpose: See the tradeoffs in an everyday decision.
use: Choosing between purchases, subscriptions, plans, or ways to get a job done.
result: A comparison grounded in your priorities, with unknowns and a practical next step.
test: Use Compare Options. I can spend at most $80 on a desk. One used desk is $40 and may need a $15 repair; a new desk is $110. I work at home twice a week. Help me compare without inventing product details.
connection: Decision and critical-thinking prompts in The Prompt Library

title: Learn Anything
purpose: Turn a topic into something you can practice.
use: Learning a new idea or practical skill in the time you actually have.
result: A clear explanation, an example, a small practice task, and feedback on your attempt.
test: Use Learn Anything. I have 10 minutes to learn fixed and variable costs. Use a community picnic as the example, give me one practice question, and wait for my answer.
connection: Learning activities and inclusive coaching across the public collection

title: Conversation Coach
purpose: Prepare for a conversation you have been putting off.
use: Giving feedback, asking for a change, setting a boundary, or practicing a respectful response.
result: A sayable opening, a clear request, and optional role-play one turn at a time.
test: Use Conversation Coach. My neighbor has twice left bins blocking our shared walkway. Help me make a respectful, specific request. Then play the neighbor for one reply and wait for me.
